timeline.summary: Epigral Limited’s conference call to discuss Q4FY26 results led by Maulik Patel, Kaushal Soparkar, Rakesh Agrawal, and Milind Kotecha scheduled for Saturday, May 2, 2026, at 4:30 PM (IST).
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹736.16 Cr (+17.3% YoY), net profit ₹80.95 Cr (-6.8% YoY).
Epigral reported Q4 FY26 revenue of ₹736 Cr and proposed a final dividend of ₹5 per share.

Epigral Limited’s Board of Directors, led by **Gaurang Trivedi** and signed by **Ghanshyam Trivedi**, recommended a final dividend of ₹5 per equity share (50% payout) for FY2025-26 on **May 2, 2026**.
Epigral Limited’s **Gaurang Trivedi** shared the Q4 FY2026 results conference call audio recording (2 May 2026) via the company website.
Epigral reported Q4 FY26 revenue of ₹736 Cr and guided to 10-12% volume growth for FY27.
Epigral submitted its Annual Report for FY 2025-26, reporting consolidated revenue of ₹2,527 Cr and net profit of ₹332 Cr with an unmodified audit opinion.
Epigral announced postal ballot results on May 20, 2026, approving the re-appointment of three independent directors.
2026-06-03: Epigral's CRISIL ratings reaffirmed at AA/Stable for ₹1,050 Cr bank facilities.
Epigral Limited announced a conference call on Monday, 2 November 2026 at 5:00 P.M. (IST) to discuss Q2 FY27 Results.
Epigral received an income tax assessment order and demand notice of ₹28.11 Cr for AY 2023-24, which it is challenging via appeal.
